column2:
tale(n.)故事、傳說
(無詞性變化)
fairy tale 童話故事
folk tale 民間故事
My grandma told me a fairy tale every night.
(我奶奶每天晚上都講一個童話故事給我聽。)
This old tale is about a brave young farmer.
(這個古老的故事是關於一位勇敢的年輕農夫。)

target(n./v.)目標、靶子、以…為目標
(無詞性變化)
sales target 銷售目標
target audience 目標觀眾
Our team finally reached the sales target this month.
(我們團隊這個月終於達到了銷售目標。)
This TV show targets young children.
(這個電視節目以幼童為目標觀眾。)

task(n./v.)任務、工作、分派任務
(無詞性變化)
a difficult task 困難的任務
complete a task 完成任務
Cleaning the whole house is not an easy task.
(打掃整間房子不是件容易的工作。)
Each student must complete the task by Friday.
(每位學生都必須在星期五前完成這項任務。)

tax(n./v.)稅、課稅
taxation(n.)課稅、稅制
pay taxes 繳稅
tax-free 免稅的
Everyone with a job has to pay taxes.
(每個有工作的人都必須繳稅。)
You can buy tax-free goods at the airport.
(你可以在機場買到免稅商品。)

teapot(n.)茶壺
(無詞性變化)
a china teapot 瓷茶壺
fill the teapot 把茶壺裝滿
She poured hot water into the teapot.
(她把熱水倒進茶壺裡。)
My aunt bought a beautiful teapot in Japan.
(我阿姨在日本買了一個漂亮的茶壺。)

tear(n./v.)眼淚、撕破
tore(v.)撕破(過去式)
torn(adj.)撕破的
in tears 流著淚
tear up 撕碎
The little girl was in tears after losing her doll.
(小女孩弄丟洋娃娃之後哭了起來。)
Please don't tear the pages out of the book.
(請不要把書頁撕下來。)

technology(n.)科技、技術
technological(adj.)科技的
modern technology 現代科技
information technology 資訊科技
Modern technology makes our lives much easier.
(現代科技讓我們的生活便利許多。)
My brother wants to study information technology in college.
(我哥哥想在大學念資訊科技。)

teens(n.)十幾歲(13到19歲)
teenager(n.)青少年
teenage(adj.)青少年的
in one's teens 在某人十幾歲時
late teens 快二十歲時
She started playing the guitar in her teens.
(她十幾歲時開始彈吉他。)
Many people in their late teens learn to drive.
(許多快二十歲的人會去學開車。)

temperature(n.)溫度、體溫
(無詞性變化)
high temperature 高溫
take one's temperature 量體溫
The temperature dropped quickly after the rain.
(下雨後氣溫迅速下降。)
The nurse took my temperature this morning.
(護理師今天早上幫我量了體溫。)

term(n./v.)學期、術語、期限、稱為
terms(n.)條件、關係
in terms of 就…而言
a technical term 專業術語
We will have three tests this term.
(這學期我們會有三次考試。)
In terms of price, this phone is a good choice.
(就價格而言，這支手機是個好選擇。)

terrorism(n.)恐怖主義、恐怖行動
terrorist(n.)恐怖分子
terror(n.)恐懼、恐怖
fight terrorism 打擊恐怖主義
an act of terrorism 恐怖行動
Many countries work together to fight terrorism.
(許多國家攜手合作打擊恐怖主義。)
The attack was called an act of terrorism.
(這次攻擊被稱為恐怖行動。)

terrorist(adj.)恐怖分子的、恐怖主義的
terrorist(n.)恐怖分子
terrorism(n.)恐怖主義
terrorist attack 恐怖攻擊
terrorist group 恐怖組織
The terrorist attack shocked the whole world.
(那起恐怖攻擊震驚了全世界。)
The police arrested two members of a terrorist group.
(警方逮捕了兩名恐怖組織成員。)

text(n.)文字、內文、簡訊
text(v.)傳簡訊
send a text 傳簡訊
text message 簡訊
I will send you a text when I get home.
(我到家時會傳簡訊給你。)
Read the text carefully before you answer.
(回答之前請仔細閱讀內文。)

textbook(n.)教科書、課本
(無詞性變化)
English textbook 英文課本
open your textbook 打開課本
Please open your textbook to page twenty.
(請把課本翻到第二十頁。)
I forgot to bring my math textbook today.
(我今天忘了帶數學課本。)

therefore(adv.)因此、所以
(無詞性變化)
and therefore 因此
therefore, ... 因此，…
It was raining; therefore, we stayed at home.
(當時在下雨，因此我們待在家裡。)
He studied hard and therefore passed the exam.
(他用功讀書，因此通過了考試。)

thief(n.)小偷、竊賊
thieves(n.)小偷(複數)
theft(n.)偷竊
car thief 偷車賊
catch a thief 抓小偷
The police finally caught the thief last night.
(警方昨晚終於抓到了小偷。)
A thief stole my bike in front of the store.
(有小偷在商店前偷了我的腳踏車。)

thirsty(adj.)口渴的、渴望的
thirst(n.)口渴
feel thirsty 覺得口渴
thirsty for knowledge 渴望知識
I feel thirsty after running in the sun.
(在太陽下跑步之後我覺得口渴。)
Can I have some water? I'm very thirsty.
(可以給我一些水嗎？我好渴。)

thought(n.)想法、思考
thoughtful(adj.)體貼的、深思的
think(v.)想、認為
on second thought 再想一想
lost in thought 陷入沉思
That's a good thought. Let's try it.
(那是個好主意，我們試試看吧。)
He sat by the window, lost in thought.
(他坐在窗邊，陷入沉思。)

throughout(prep./adv.)遍及、從頭到尾
(無詞性變化)
throughout the year 一整年
throughout the world 全世界
This shop is open throughout the year.
(這家店全年無休。)
The singer is famous throughout the world.
(這位歌手聞名全世界。)

thunder(n./v.)雷、打雷
thunderstorm(n.)雷雨
a clap of thunder 一聲雷響
thunder and lightning 雷電
My dog is afraid of thunder.
(我的狗很怕打雷。)
It thundered all night, so I couldn't sleep.
(整晚都在打雷，所以我睡不著。)

thus(adv.)因此、如此
(無詞性變化)
and thus 因而
thus far 到目前為止
He didn't study and thus failed the test.
(他沒有讀書，因而考試不及格。)
Thus far, everything has gone well.
(到目前為止，一切都很順利。)

till(conj./prep.)直到
(無詞性變化)
till now 直到現在
from morning till night 從早到晚
Wait here till I come back.
(在這裡等到我回來。)
She works from morning till night.
(她從早工作到晚。)

tiny(adj.)極小的、微小的
(無詞性變化)
a tiny bit 一點點
tiny room 很小的房間
The baby has tiny hands and feet.
(這個寶寶有小小的手和腳。)
They live in a tiny apartment in the city.
(他們住在城裡一間很小的公寓。)

tire(v./n.)使疲倦、輪胎
tired(adj.)疲倦的、厭倦的
tiring(adj.)令人疲倦的
flat tire 爆胎、沒氣的輪胎
be tired of 厭倦
Our car got a flat tire on the way.
(我們的車在路上爆胎了。)
Long walks tire my grandfather easily.
(長距離散步很容易讓我爺爺疲累。)

tissue(n.)面紙、(生物)組織
(無詞性變化)
a box of tissues 一盒面紙
body tissue 身體組織
Can you pass me a tissue, please?
(可以請你遞一張面紙給我嗎？)
Muscle tissue needs time to heal after exercise.
(肌肉組織在運動後需要時間修復。)

title(n./v.)標題、頭銜、給…加標題
(無詞性變化)
book title 書名
win the title 贏得冠軍頭銜
What is the title of this song?
(這首歌的歌名是什麼？)
Our team won the title last year.
(我們隊去年贏得了冠軍。)

toast(n./v.)吐司、敬酒、烤
toaster(n.)烤麵包機
a slice of toast 一片吐司
make a toast 敬酒
I had toast and milk for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了吐司配牛奶。)
Let's make a toast to the happy couple.
(讓我們向這對新人敬酒。)

tofu(n.)豆腐
(無詞性變化)
stinky tofu 臭豆腐
fried tofu 炸豆腐
Stinky tofu is a famous Taiwanese snack.
(臭豆腐是有名的台灣小吃。)
My mom made soup with tofu and fish.
(我媽媽用豆腐和魚煮了湯。)

tone(n.)語氣、音調、色調
(無詞性變化)
tone of voice 說話的語氣
in a friendly tone 用友善的語氣
Don't talk to me in that tone.
(不要用那種語氣跟我說話。)
The teacher spoke in a friendly tone.
(老師用友善的語氣說話。)

tongue(n.)舌頭、語言
(無詞性變化)
mother tongue 母語
stick out one's tongue 吐舌頭
Chinese is my mother tongue.
(中文是我的母語。)
The boy stuck out his tongue at his sister.
(男孩對他妹妹吐舌頭。)

toothache(n.)牙痛
(無詞性變化)
have a toothache 牙痛
a bad toothache 嚴重牙痛
I have a toothache, so I can't eat candy.
(我牙痛，所以不能吃糖果。)
He went to the dentist because of a bad toothache.
(他因為牙痛得厲害去看牙醫。)

toothbrush(n.)牙刷
(無詞性變化)
electric toothbrush 電動牙刷
a new toothbrush 新牙刷
You should change your toothbrush every three months.
(你應該每三個月換一次牙刷。)
I forgot to pack my toothbrush for the trip.
(我旅行時忘了帶牙刷。)

tour(n./v.)旅行、參觀、巡迴
tourist(n.)觀光客
tourism(n.)觀光業
guided tour 有導覽的遊覽
go on a tour 去旅遊
We went on a tour of the old city.
(我們去遊覽了古城。)
The band will tour Asia next year.
(那個樂團明年將在亞洲巡迴演出。)

toward(prep.)朝向、對於
towards(prep.)朝向、對於(英式拼法)
walk toward 朝…走去
attitude toward 對…的態度
The dog ran toward me happily.
(那隻狗開心地朝我跑來。)
Her attitude toward work is very good.
(她對工作的態度非常好。)

track(n./v.)軌道、跑道、足跡、追蹤
(無詞性變化)
keep track of 記錄、掌握…的動態
on the right track 方向正確
I use an app to keep track of my spending.
(我用一個應用程式記錄我的花費。)
The runners are warming up on the track.
(跑者們正在跑道上暖身。)

trade(n./v.)貿易、交易、交換
trader(n.)商人
trade with 與…貿易
trade A for B 用A換B
Taiwan has close trade with many countries.
(台灣與許多國家有密切的貿易往來。)
I traded my comic book for his toy car.
(我用我的漫畫書換了他的玩具車。)

tradition(n.)傳統、慣例
traditional(adj.)傳統的
family tradition 家族傳統
follow a tradition 遵循傳統
Eating moon cakes is a Mid-Autumn tradition.
(吃月餅是中秋節的傳統。)
It is our family tradition to eat together on Sundays.
(星期天一起吃飯是我們家的傳統。)

traditional(adj.)傳統的
tradition(n.)傳統
traditionally(adv.)傳統上
traditional food 傳統食物
traditional culture 傳統文化
Beef noodles are a traditional food in Taiwan.
(牛肉麵是台灣的傳統食物。)
She wore a traditional dress at the festival.
(她在節慶上穿了傳統服裝。)

trap(n./v.)陷阱、困住、誘捕
(無詞性變化)
set a trap 設陷阱
be trapped in 被困在
The farmer set a trap to catch the mouse.
(農夫設了陷阱來抓老鼠。)
We were trapped in the elevator for an hour.
(我們被困在電梯裡一個小時。)

trash(n./v.)垃圾、丟棄
(無詞性變化)
take out the trash 倒垃圾
trash can 垃圾桶
It's your turn to take out the trash.
(輪到你倒垃圾了。)
Please throw the paper cup into the trash can.
(請把紙杯丟進垃圾桶。)

travel(n./v.)旅行、行進
traveler(n.)旅客
travel abroad 出國旅行
travel agency 旅行社
My family likes to travel abroad in summer.
(我家人喜歡在夏天出國旅行。)
Light travels faster than sound.
(光速比音速快。)

treasure(n./v.)寶藏、寶物、珍惜
(無詞性變化)
hidden treasure 隱藏的寶藏
treasure map 藏寶圖
The pirates buried their treasure on an island.
(海盜把他們的寶藏埋在一座島上。)
I treasure the time I spend with my friends.
(我很珍惜和朋友相處的時光。)

trial(n.)審判、試驗、試用
try(v.)嘗試、審判
on trial 受審
trial and error 反覆嘗試、試誤
The man is on trial for stealing a car.
(那名男子因偷車而受審。)
I learned to cook by trial and error.
(我是靠反覆嘗試學會做菜的。)

triangle(n.)三角形
triangular(adj.)三角形的
draw a triangle 畫一個三角形
love triangle 三角戀
Please draw a triangle on the board.
(請在黑板上畫一個三角形。)
The movie is about a love triangle.
(這部電影是關於一段三角戀。)

trick(n./v.)詭計、把戲、竅門、欺騙
tricky(adj.)棘手的、狡猾的
play a trick on 捉弄某人
magic trick 魔術把戲
My brother likes to play tricks on me.
(我弟弟喜歡捉弄我。)
The man tricked her into giving him money.
(那個男人騙她給他錢。)

true(adj./adv./v.)真的、真實的、正確地、校準
truly(adv.)真正地、真誠地
truth(n.)事實、真相
come true 實現
true or false 是非題、對或錯
I hope your dream will come true.
(我希望你的夢想會實現。)
Is it true that he moved to Japan?
(他搬到日本是真的嗎？)

trust(v./n.)信任、相信
trustworthy(adj.)值得信賴的
trust in 信賴…
build trust 建立信任
You can trust me with your secret.
(你可以放心把祕密告訴我。)
It takes time to build trust between friends.
(朋友之間建立信任需要時間。)

truth(n.)事實、真相、真理
true(adj.)真的
truthful(adj.)誠實的
tell the truth 說實話
the truth is 事實是
Please tell me the truth.
(請告訴我實話。)
The truth is that I forgot your birthday.
(事實是我忘了你的生日。)

tube(n.)管子、管狀容器、(英國)地鐵
(無詞性變化)
a tube of toothpaste 一條牙膏
test tube 試管
I need to buy a new tube of toothpaste.
(我需要買一條新的牙膏。)
The scientist put the liquid into a test tube.
(科學家把液體倒進試管裡。)

turtle(n.)烏龜、海龜
(無詞性變化)
sea turtle 海龜
as slow as a turtle 像烏龜一樣慢
We saw a sea turtle while swimming.
(我們游泳時看到了一隻海龜。)
My little brother keeps a turtle as a pet.
(我弟弟養了一隻烏龜當寵物。)

typhoon(n.)颱風
(無詞性變化)
typhoon day off 颱風假
strong typhoon 強烈颱風
School was closed because of the typhoon.
(因為颱風，學校停課了。)
A strong typhoon hit Taiwan last week.
(上週一個強烈颱風侵襲台灣。)

typical(adj.)典型的、一向如此的
type(n.)類型
typically(adv.)通常、典型地
a typical day 典型的一天
typical of 是…的特點
Let me tell you about a typical day at school.
(讓我告訴你我在學校典型的一天。)
It's typical of him to be late.
(遲到是他一貫的作風。)

ugly(adj.)醜的、難看的、令人不快的
ugliness(n.)醜陋
ugly duckling 醜小鴨
turn ugly 變得難看、惡化
I think this sweater is really ugly.
(我覺得這件毛衣真的很醜。)
The argument turned ugly very quickly.
(這場爭吵很快就變得很難看。)

umbrella(n.)雨傘
(無詞性變化)
open an umbrella 打開雨傘
bring an umbrella 帶傘
Don't forget to bring an umbrella today.
(今天別忘了帶傘。)
She shared her umbrella with me in the rain.
(她在雨中和我共撐一把傘。)

unit(n.)單位、單元、一組
unite(v.)團結、聯合
unit of measurement 計量單位
Unit One 第一單元
We will have a test on Unit Three tomorrow.
(我們明天要考第三單元。)
The meter is a unit of length.
(公尺是長度的單位。)

universe(n.)宇宙、全世界
universal(adj.)普遍的、全世界的
the whole universe 整個宇宙
the origin of the universe 宇宙的起源
Scientists still study the origin of the universe.
(科學家們仍在研究宇宙的起源。)
Is there other life in the universe?
(宇宙中還有其他生命嗎？)

university(n.)大學
(無詞性變化)
go to university 上大學
university student 大學生
My sister is a university student in Taipei.
(我姊姊是台北的大學生。)
He hopes to go to university abroad.
(他希望去國外念大學。)

unless(conj.)除非、如果不
(無詞性變化)
unless otherwise noted 除非另有註明
not... unless 除非…否則不
You will miss the bus unless you hurry.
(除非你快一點，否則會錯過公車。)
Don't call me unless it's important.
(除非有重要的事，否則別打電話給我。)

upload(v.)上傳
download(v.)下載
upload photos 上傳照片
upload a video 上傳影片
She uploaded the photos to her blog.
(她把照片上傳到她的部落格。)
Please upload your homework before Friday.
(請在星期五之前上傳你的作業。)

upon(prep.)在…之上、一…就
(無詞性變化)
once upon a time 從前
upon arrival 一抵達就
Once upon a time, there lived a kind king.
(從前，有一位仁慈的國王。)
Please call me upon arrival.
(抵達後請馬上打電話給我。)

upper(adj.)上面的、較高的
(無詞性變化)
upper floor 樓上
upper class 上流社會
My office is on the upper floor.
(我的辦公室在樓上。)
He hurt his upper arm while playing basketball.
(他打籃球時傷到了上臂。)

upset(adj./v./n.)心煩的、使心煩、打亂、(比賽)爆冷
(無詞性變化)
get upset 生氣、難過
upset stomach 腸胃不適
She got upset when she lost her phone.
(她弄丟手機時很難過。)
Don't upset your mother with bad news.
(別用壞消息讓你媽媽心煩。)

upstairs(adv./adj./n.)在樓上、樓上的、樓上
downstairs(adv.)在樓下
go upstairs 上樓
upstairs neighbor 樓上鄰居
My bedroom is upstairs.
(我的臥室在樓上。)
Our upstairs neighbor is very noisy at night.
(我們樓上的鄰居晚上很吵。)

used(adj.)用過的、二手的、習慣的
use(v.)使用
used car 二手車
be used to 習慣於
My father bought a used car last month.
(我爸爸上個月買了一輛二手車。)
I am used to getting up early.
(我習慣早起。)

user(n.)使用者、用戶
use(v.)使用
user-friendly 容易使用的
internet user 網路使用者
This app is very user-friendly.
(這個應用程式非常容易使用。)
The number of internet users is growing fast.
(網路使用者的數量成長得很快。)

usual(adj.)平常的、通常的
usually(adv.)通常
as usual 照常、一如往常
than usual 比平常
He was late for class as usual.
(他一如往常上課遲到了。)
It is colder than usual today.
(今天比平常冷。)

vacation(n./v.)假期、度假
(無詞性變化)
summer vacation 暑假
on vacation 在度假
What did you do during summer vacation?
(你暑假做了什麼？)
My parents are on vacation in Japan.
(我爸媽正在日本度假。)

valley(n.)山谷、溪谷
(無詞性變化)
a deep valley 深谷
river valley 河谷
There is a small village in the valley.
(山谷裡有一個小村莊。)
We hiked down into the deep valley.
(我們徒步走下深谷。)

valuable(adj.)貴重的、有價值的
value(n.)價值
valuables(n.)貴重物品
valuable experience 寶貴的經驗
valuable information 有價值的資訊
Working part-time gave me valuable experience.
(打工給了我寶貴的經驗。)
Don't leave valuable things in your car.
(別把貴重物品留在車上。)

value(n./v.)價值、價值觀、重視
valuable(adj.)有價值的
value friendship 重視友誼
family values 家庭價值觀
I value my friends very much.
(我非常重視我的朋友。)
This old coin has a high value.
(這枚古錢幣價值很高。)

victory(n.)勝利
victorious(adj.)勝利的
win a victory 獲勝
victory over 戰勝…
Our team celebrated the victory together.
(我們隊一起慶祝勝利。)
They won a great victory over the champions.
(他們大勝了冠軍隊伍。)

view(n./v.)景色、觀點、看待、觀看
viewer(n.)觀眾
point of view 觀點
a view of the sea 海景
The hotel room has a great view of the sea.
(這間飯店房間有很棒的海景。)
Everyone has a different point of view.
(每個人都有不同的觀點。)

village(n.)村莊
villager(n.)村民
a small village 小村莊
village life 鄉村生活
My grandparents live in a small village.
(我的祖父母住在一個小村莊裡。)
The whole village came to the party.
(全村的人都來參加了派對。)

vote(n./v.)投票、選票
voter(n.)投票者、選民
vote for 投票支持
cast a vote 投下一票
We voted for a new class leader today.
(我們今天投票選出新班長。)
Every vote counts in an election.
(選舉中每一票都很重要。)
